meta.title: Surokkha BD: be ready, stay safe
meta.description: Free guides, safe places, and community help for every natural disaster in Bangladesh.

hero.title: Be ready. Stay safe.
hero.subtitle: Free guides, safe places, and community help for every natural disaster in Bangladesh.

hazards.title: Every hazard, one palette each
hazards.intro: Each disaster gets its own color. Select one to see how the interface changes.
hazards.previewNote: Full guides with before, during, and after steps arrive in the next phase.

severity.title: Severity you can read at a glance
severity.intro: Every level has its own shape and a written label, so it never depends on color alone.

footer.disclaimer: Surokkha BD is not an official warning source. Always follow alerts from the Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) and the Department of Disaster Management (DDM).
footer.status: Project foundation preview. Content and data are placeholders until they are verified against official sources.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist or has moved.

hazardPage.draftNotice: This guide is a draft and is being reviewed against official sources.
hazardPage.readAloudUnsupported: Read-aloud is not supported on this device.

contacts.title: Emergency contacts
contacts.intro: One-tap call. These are shared numbers for the whole country.
contacts.sourceNote: Numbers are checked against public sources. Always confirm locally when possible.

plan.title: My safety plan
plan.intro: Answer a few questions to get a personal checklist you can save or print.
plan.privacyNote: This plan is saved only on your device. It is not sent anywhere.
plan.familySize: Number of people in your family

checklist.documents: ID and documents in a waterproof bag
checklist.phone: Charged phone and a power bank
checklist.elderly: Extra time and help planned for elderly members
checklist.children: Comfort items and ID tags for young children
checklist.disability: Mobility aids and any needed support planned
checklist.livestock: A safe place identified for livestock

map.title: Live map
map.intro: Shelters and recent earthquakes in and around Bangladesh, on one map.
map.shelterSource: Shelters: curated sample for this preview
map.quakeError: Could not load earthquake data right now.
map.noQuakes: No earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or higher in the last 30 days.

shelters.title: Find a shelter
shelters.intro: Find the nearest cyclone shelter, flood shelter, or hospital.
shelters.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Choose your district instead.
shelters.locationUnsupported: Location is not supported on this device. Choose your district instead.
shelters.emptyState: Use your location or choose a district to see the nearest shelters.
shelters.sourceNote: This is a curated sample of shelters for this preview, not a complete list. A full dataset from DDM and OpenStreetMap is planned for a later phase.
